WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owneris the ownerinfee title of acertain parcel of land,with thebuildings and improvements thereon, in the City, County and State of New York, known as and by the street address 136 William Street and the tax lot Block 77, Lot 18 and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part of hereof (said land and tax lots being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as"Owner's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements being hereinafter referred to as "Owner'sProperty"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee title or contract purchaser of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City, County and State of New York,known as and by the street addresses 130 William Street and the tax lot Block 77, Lot 15 and more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part thereof (said land and tax lots being referred to herein as "Developer's Land"; the building and improvements thereon are herein referred to as the “Existing Developer Buildin"; WHEREAS, Developer intends, to construct a new building or modify or alter the existing building upon all or a portion of Developer's Land (said new building or modification of the existing building, with any further additions, alterations and replacements thereof, being herein called the "New Building"; and said land and New Building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as "Developer's Property"); Owner's Land and Developer's Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the "Parcels" and each individually as a"Parcel"); WHEREAS,it is contemplated that theNewBuilding will contain more floor area (herein referred to as "Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961 (the "Zoning Resolution") than is now available for use under the"floor area ratio" limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution related to Developer's Land as an independent "zoning lot", with the result that Developer desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining Developer's Land and

Owner's Land into a single "zoning lot" for the purpose of determining compliance by the New Buildingwithsuchlimitation; WHEREAS,thereexistFloorAreaDevelopmentRights(hereinafter defined)which are appurtenant to Owner's Land which are in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights utilized by Owner's Building (hereinafter,“Excess Floor Area Development Rights") and the same are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution.
